identity.confidence: High identity confidence; exact feature and official business address agree.

provenance: Source URLs, providers, snapshot dates, source CRS, methods, and uncertainty are detailed in sources/source_catalog.json. Raw snapshots include the named OSM way and mapped Northwestern Avenue segment. The storefront image is saved locally with its source URL and 2022 post date recorded.

before.geometry: Simple 4-corner extruded shell; 16 m height had no height source.

placement_and_plan.footprint_source: OpenStreetMap way 116427257, retained from the repository snapshot dated 2026-10-22.
placement_and_plan.method: Four source vertices were transformed from EPSG:4326 with the documented Purdue local conversion; the structural bottom ring preserves these coordinates.
placement_and_plan.match: Maximum nearest-vertex distance is 0.000525 m and mean is 0.000382 m, due to source/output coordinate precision.
placement_and_plan.orientation: No rotation or translation applied. The asset's east short face is nearest the mapped Northwestern Avenue line and was modeled as the storefront face; photo orientation itself is not georeferenced.
placement_and_plan.uncertainty: Purdue's reviewed official BuildingShapesZip4 reference has no exact-name/code match for this off-campus shop. The OSM footprint is the sole saved building polygon.

vertical_geometry.observed_levels: Two distinct exterior levels are visible in the 2022 storefront photo.
vertical_geometry.height_status: Estimated, not measured. Height is a conservative two-floor interpretation and roof parapet from the photograph. No survey, section, or reliable published elevation was found.
vertical_geometry.roof: Flat, dark roof/parapet, simplified from the photograph; exact roofline is not fully visible.

facade.modeling_status: Generalized facades with a centered entrance, display windows and upper windows. Exact window size/rhythm, wall material boundaries, sign dimensions, branding placement on side walls and hidden elevations remain approximate.

edits: Preserved the original four-corner OSM footprint and campus placement.
Reduced unsupported 16 m extrusion to an 8.38 m visual estimate for the two-level storefront.
Added lower gray masonry storefront, upper light siding, display glazing, upper sash windows, wrapped black awning, projecting sign lettering and a flat roof cap.
Removed unused image-texture datablocks and joined geometry into the expected single export mesh.

validation.export: Passed: exact expected collection and one mesh object; no modifiers, external images, or linked libraries.
